svg.title: A backup channel for work outages?
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Differ Impact is the weighted score out of 100. Differ Rank orders all twenty arguments from highest to lowest impact. Exact ties use the earlier pick, then the permanent argument ID.
svg.text: A backup channel for work outages?
Should employers pay for a backup way to reach staff when work apps go down?

g.title: Michael Reed · Pay for a backup channel · Support · 1
Jennifer Park · Use existing emergency contacts · Support · 0
Independent channel — Separate alerts from the main sign-in.
g.text: Separate alerts from the main sign-in.

g.title: Phone tree — Small teams can call existing numbers.
g.text: Small teams can call existing numbers.

g.title: Critical shifts — Send schedule changes to on-call staff.
g.text: Send schedule changes to on-call staff.

g.title: Subscription fees — Avoid monthly fees for rare outages.
g.text: Avoid monthly fees for rare outages.

g.title: Trusted updates — Give staff one source of instructions.

g.text: Remember one number or meeting place.
